property: Cumulative ACK semantics remain part of TCP while an option adds explicit reporting of additional non-contiguous received blocks for improved loss recovery.

sources.supports: SACK supplements cumulative acknowledgment rather than replacing it

negative_claims: This edge does not claim cumulative ACK was obsolete after SACK.
This edge does not claim SACK itself defines the complete sender congestion-control algorithm.
open_questions: Trace first production SACK deployments and later recovery algorithms.
notes: Example of old feedback semantics surviving beneath a richer optional feedback layer.
